critique.evidence: Strong cyber-lab art direction, disciplined red/cyan/amber palette, confident headline, and coherent card styling across viewports. However, desktop composition is uneven: the phylogeny graphic is extremely small inside a large empty panel, while secondary copy, labels, axes, and mobile metadata are often near-illegible. Tablet/mobile stacking is orderly but produces a long, visually repetitive column. The global header feels clipped rather than intentionally responsive: tablet/mobile hide most destinations, the active Arena item is not visible, and mobile reduces the brand to an unexplained icon. Contrast proof is also incomplete for 12 mobile header links and one tablet link.
critique.fix: Enlarge or recompose the desktop phylogeny visualization to occupy its panel, raise minimum type size and contrast for metadata/chart labels, and tighten excess vertical space. Give mobile cards stronger grouping and rhythm. Redesign the compact header with a persistent wordmark or clear menu, visible active-section state, and an explicit overflow affordance; then verify nav-link contrast.
